incumbent_comparison: The MPFB challenger is a substantial anatomical and material improvement over primitive citizen-v007 and integrates the full human rig and Clockwork equipment. It remains a challenger; preserve citizen-v007 as the stable gameplay incumbent and label the MPFB candidate BEST CURRENT / PRODUCTION ART FOLLOW-UP REQUIRED in any separate showcase.
likely_causes: A 0.5-inch citizen occupies only about 40 pixels in the 12-inch production view, so helmet optics, workwear, and equipment occupy few pixels.
The front role tool is production-owned and must remain visible; it masks part of the apron in the front close capture.
Repeated isolated 50-citizen performance has not been measured on a quiet controlled GPU workload.
next_action_hypothesis: This was the bounded follow-up to v086. Do not continue with another seam, hem, or small silhouette iteration for POC 2.5. Use the best current MPFB human in a separate showcase registry, keep citizen-v007 as the accepted production incumbent, and record character identity, animation, and mass-use cost as production-art follow-up.

observations.art_direction_fit: Helmet, twin goggles, pressure pack, canvas workwear, teal coat, leather, and brass fit the Clockwork workshop-worker target, but identity remains weak at crowd scale.
observations.close_up_quality: Approximately two-inch detail/profile/three-quarter views show attached equipment, fitted clothing, anatomy, and boots coherently; smaller tailoring and pose issues remain.
observations.gameplay_readability: The front production-owned tool still occludes the lower apron; flared tails are subtle at gameplay scale and the 12-inch facing sweep remains insufficient for a strict pass.
observations.geometric_detail: The complete fitted body, helmet optics, pack, boots, and workwear are geometric; Godot reports 103676 triangles.
observations.material_realism: Textured teal work cloth, warm canvas, leather, brass, iron, glass, and skin have differentiated PBR response.
observations.proportion: The human remains fitted to the established half-inch envelope; some torso/equipment bulk remains a production-art refinement.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot imports the candidate at exactly 0.26 x 0.50 x 0.21 inches with the established 53-bone rig, five pivots, and 9+9 LOD meshes.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The Clockwork worker identity is apparent in close equipment views but is not immediately unmistakable across the 12-inch 50-citizen facings.
observations.silhouette_quality: Human proportions are coherent. Helmet, pressure pack, work coat, and apron/tails add a professional silhouette, but do not dominate the gameplay-distance image.
observations.surface_variation: Separate inherited maps provide fabric, leather, metal, helmet, and lens variation; the asset is not materially flat.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 validation passes with exact bounds, 18 meshes, 42 surfaces, 103676 triangles, 53 bones, five pivots, and seven live RoomScale captures plus supplemental stills.

close_inspection.evidence: At the approximately two-inch inspection view, anatomy, helmet, paired lenses, fitted workwear, pressure pack, boots, and material boundaries remain coherent; ordinary production-art refinement needs remain.

edge_treatment.evidence: Helmet guard, optical housings, workwear panels, and boot pieces have formed edges and visible thickness in close/profile captures.

hardware.evidence: Paired brass-rimmed lenses, strap fittings, pack ferrules, gauge, hose, and garment buckles are present and attached.

joins.evidence: Optics connect to the helmet cage, pressure equipment connects through its frame and straps, and garment pieces are skinned into the existing human rig.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Tailored workwear, mechanical helmet, twin pressure pack, layered boots, and fasteners read as manufactured pieces at close inspection.

material_response.evidence: Textured cloth, warm canvas, leather, brass, iron, teal glass, and skin remain visually distinct in production views.

surface_variation.evidence: Inherited textile, leather, helmet, metal, and glass maps preserve distinct surface and roughness response.

thickness.evidence: Helmet shell, goggle barrels, apron/tails, harness, reservoirs, and boot construction retain thickness in profile/detail.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: Godot close, profile, and three-quarter renders show coherent human anatomy, fitted textile clothing, a layered mechanical helmet and paired optics, connected pressure equipment, and manufactured footwear. The candidate is not low-poly, primitive, placeholder, or materially flat.
